''See also: [[The Last Horizon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Last [[Horizon]] is a legendary [[Zenith Era]] starship, often categorized as a [[Zenith Device]]. While many consider it a myth, scholars and technicians believe it is the most likely of its kind to still exist in the modern era. The vessel is described as a light cruiser, measuring between four hundred and five hundred yards in length, with an organic appearance. Its dark metal hull is smooth and shaped like a diving bird of prey, featuring plates that glow with various colors such as blue-green, orange, or purple at the seams and joints. The ship's interior is noted for its flawless, perfect construction. As a piece of advanced [[Aethertech]], the ship is rumored to be powered by enchantments from an astral [[dragon]], three [[World Spirits]], and several [[Archmagi]]. Its legendary capabilities include the ability to terraform entire systems in weeks, [[construct]] colonies or fleets in seconds, transport crew across the galaxy without using [[Subspace]], and conjure copies of itself from the [[Aether]]. It also possesses weapons comparable to major dreadnoughts, capable of piercing planets or freezing the motion of celestial bodies. The ship is a polarizing entity; some view it as a herald of [[destruction]] that terrorizes worlds, while others admire its unprecedented power. It operates with a specific crew, including a Captain and an [[Engineer]], and is capable of manifesting an intelligence or persona named [[Horizon]]. Although it has faced significant damage in combat, leaving behind fragments of itself, it remains a formidable force in the galaxy.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|As the original [[Aethertech]] starship, The Last [[Horizon]] is a legendary light cruiser that enabled early humanity's colonization of the stars. Also known as the Chariot of the [[Star]]-Queens, this [[Zenith Device]] is a vessel that can be competed for in a virtual competition and may be connected to the cloudy orange planet. The ship features an organic metal bridge, a hangar with indestructible doors, and smooth halls, though it requires a Captain to function fully as its power is derived from the crew. This symbiotic fellowship accepts only six crew members, whose likenesses are illustrated on [[stone]] tablets within the ship. After bringing [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] to the [[iron mountain]], the vessel emerged from [[Subspace]] and eventually faced severe damage during a battle against the [[Iron King]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Last [[Horizon]] is a dark metal starship with smooth plates that shine blue-green at the edges, intended to serve as Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax's flagship. This vessel, which utilizes hiding for protection rather than invisibility spells, possesses the mythical abilities of terraforming and constructing fleets while providing fabricator technology and schematics. As a group that requires worthy heroes and specific recruitment qualifications, the ship is home to a rogue crew with no allegiances, including the Knight [[Raion Raithe]] and the narrator. Despite being dwarfed by a planet's crust and sustaining damage after facing the full force of the [[Iron Legion]], the ship features a wide, greenish metal weapons laboratory and various scanners and shuttles. Ultimately, after reverting to a pile of dead metal, the remaining crew returned for their captain as the ship rose once more to face [[Starhammer]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Last [[Horizon]] is a starship at least five hundred yards long, shaped like a predatory bird in a dive and constructed with [[Zenith Era alloys]]. This vessel, which is commanded by [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] and features firepower surpassing that of the [[Divine Titans]], prints organic-looking ships covered in dark metal plates. As a group associated with the hero [[Horizon]] and the source of [[memory manifestation magic]], it includes [[Raion Raithe]], a Knight who represents the entity in duels. During its journey through [[Alliance space]], the ship was surrounded by [[Visiri]] vessels and targeted by a trap, causing its hallways to tremble from the impact of hits. The vessel serves as a location for Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax's duties and contains a medical room that utilizes healing magic and [[Aethertech]] to treat many patients in a small space.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Last [[Horizon]] is a starship and group known for defending planets from the [[D’Niss]] and assisting victims during the [[Visiria]] relief effort. While [[Solstice]] seeks to form an alliance with them, the crew faces widespread opposition as enemies of the [[Vallenar Corporation]] and the [[Galactic Union]]. During a dangerous quest, the vessel utilizes non-standard, planet-scorching weaponry and specialized fabrication capabilities to protect systems. The ship houses mages who have studied [[Zenith Devices]], and it remains a powerful entity capable of bombarding research centers or providing emergency extractions via its advanced systems.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“The Zenith Starship, known by its ID The Last Horizon, is the original Aethertech—”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“It is said that colonization of the stars by early humanity was only possible thanks to the creation of The Last Horizon.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|I remembered the impenetrable metal doors. “Can we hide in there?” 
“It’s virtually indestructible.”<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“We’re being hailed, Your Highness! The ship identifies itself as The Last Horizon.”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“If The Last Horizon sees our abilities and judges one of us superior, I will be satisfied.”<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c4" />}}
